purpose: Brief for the Ksandra waitlist site. The facts come from the founder's interview. Claims below are the owner's own and must be confirmed true before launch.

site.name: Ksandra
site.one_liner: Connect your notes, Google Drive and PDFs, then ask questions across hundreds of documents to prep for things like an investor meeting.

audience.icp: Startup founders preparing for investor meetings, with hundreds of documents spread across notes apps, Google Drive, Slack and PDFs.

hypothesis: Startup founders with many documents across several tools will join a waitlist for one place to ask questions and get answers, for example to prepare for an investor meeting.

blocks.headline: Stop Searching, Start Asking.

rules: No stock or generated photos or screenshots are fetched or invented.
The hero background and the product preview start as neutral placeholders, the preview labelled 'Concept preview'.
The owner uploads both through the owner area and gives each a description.

look.accent_note: Choose one warm amber accent that suits a dark, calm, frontier-inspired look with a full-width Mars hero, and record it. Keep body text high-contrast. Clean modern font.

owner.sign_in: One owner, from environment configuration. The email and password hash are supplied when the site is deployed.
areas: signups: totals, goal progress, breakdowns, list, CSV download
page content: Hero, Preview, Benefits, Waitlist, Footer

storage.photos: A storage adapter: local disk for development, Vercel Blob when deployed

stack: See the Builder's knowledge/stack.json. Those decisions are fixed.
not_in_this_version: Testimonials, customer logos or user counts
assumptions: Today's alternatives were not stated by the owner; recorded as 'Not stated' and competitors are kept off the page. Accepted by the owner.

Look chosen by default from the owner's reference (Perplexity-style hero of futuristic landscapes): deep-tech preset, dark and calm, one warm amber accent, clean modern font, brand words curious, confident, futuristic. Accepted by the owner.
The headline was drafted as 'Walk into every investor meeting prepared.' and changed by the owner to 'Stop Searching, Start Asking.'
The subheadline, benefit texts, section headings, button label, thank-you message, privacy note and footer tagline were drafted by the interviewer; the owner reviewed them.
The tools-use multiple choice on the form was suggested by the interviewer and accepted by the owner.

The product preview is a designed placeholder labelled 'Concept preview' (chat on the left, sources on the right), not a generated image; the owner uploads the real hero Mars image and any preview later.
The three unconfirmed claims were stated by the owner as included to build trust; the product is not built yet, so none is confirmed.
